create_document_extractor: create a DocumentExtractor instance to extract structured data from PDF and image documents using a VLM pipeline
extract_document: extract structured content from a single PDF or image file using a DocumentExtractor with an extraction template
extract_all_documents: extract structured content from multiple PDF or image files in batch using DocumentExtractor.extract_all
configure_extraction_formats: configure allowed input formats and per-format extraction options when initializing a DocumentExtractor
reuse_cached_pipelines: reuse cached extraction pipelines across documents by hashing pipeline options for efficient batch extraction
